units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 4) upon appointment by transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position in the cases provided for by points 3-14 of part 5 and points 3-5 of part 6 of Article 25 of this Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 5) upon appointment to a civil service position of a civil servant or citizen included in the civil service personnel reserve formed in accordance with Article 53 of this Law;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 6) in other cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 3. A competition may be omitted for appointment to particular civil service positions whose duties involve the use of state secrets, according to a list of positions approved by a normative act of the state body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 4. By decision of the employer's representative, a competition may be omitted for appointment to positions in the junior group of civil service positions, and in other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 5. An applicant for a civil service position may be refused admission to the competition because they do not meet the qualification requirements for the vacant civil service position, or because of restrictions established by civil service legislation on entry into and performance of the civil service.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 6. An applicant for a civil service position who is refused admission to a competition may challenge that decision in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 7. A competition commission shall be established by an act of the relevant state body to conduct the competition.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 8. The competition commission includes the employer’s representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters and the subdivision in which the competition is being held), as well as independent experts included in the commission in accordance with part 8.2 of Article 22 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants’ professional service activities and in personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the competition commission. An independent expert’s term on the competition commission is determined in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 8.1. In an executive authority of the City of Moscow at which a public council has been established in accordance with a legal act of the City of Moscow, the competition commission shall include representatives of that public council in addition to the persons specified in part 8 of this Article. Those representatives and independent experts together must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the competition commission.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 9. Where a competition is held to fill a civil service position whose official duties involve the use of state secrets, the competition commission shall be formed taking account of the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 10. The competition commission shall be formed so as to exclude the possibility of a conflict of interest that could affect the outcome of decisions taken by the commission.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 11. An applicant for a civil service position may challenge the competition commission’s decision in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Entry into the civil service and filling a civil service position through a competitive selection procedure
units.text: 12. The regulation on competitions, determining the procedure and conditions for conducting them, is established by federal regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 18

units.locator: Chapter 5. Service contract
units.text: Chapter 5. Service contract
units.label: Chapter 5. Service contract

units.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
units.text: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
units.label: Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract is an agreement between the employer’s representative and a citizen entering the civil service concerning performance of the civil service and holding a civil service position, or between the employer’s representative and a civil servant concerning holding a civil service position. The service contract establishes the rights and duties of the parties.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
units.text: 2. The employer’s representative undertakes to provide a citizen entering the civil service with the opportunity to perform the civil service, to provide that citizen or civil servant with the opportunity to hold a specified civil service position, to ensure their performance of the civil service and holding of the position in accordance with civil service legislation, to pay the civil servant’s monetary remuneration in full and on time, and to provide state social guarantees.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Concept and parties to a service contract
units.text: 3. A citizen entering the civil service, when concluding a service contract on performance of civil service and holding a civil service position, and a civil servant, when concluding a service contract on holding a civil service position, undertake to perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations and observe the state body's service rules.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.label: Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract states its date and place of conclusion; the name of the state body; the employer's representative's position, surname, given name and patronymic (if any); the title, date and number of the legal act determining that representative's legal status and authority to conclude the service contract; the surname, given name and patronymic (if any) of the citizen or civil servant appointed to the civil service position; and details of that person's identity document.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 2. The terms of a service contract include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 1) the title of the civil service position held, specifying the state body's structural subdivision (if any) and the place of service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 2) the date of commencement of official duties and the duration of the service contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 3) the rights, duties and liability of the civil servant provided for in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, and the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 4) the rights, duties and liability of the employer’s representative provided for in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 5) remuneration conditions (the civil servant’s monthly salary for the civil service position held, monthly salary for the civil service class rank conferred, allowances and other payments, including those linked to the results of their professional service activities) established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 6) the arrangements for service time and rest time (where these differ for the civil servant from the service rules established in the state body);
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 7) conditions of professional service activity, and compensation and benefits for professional service activity in arduous, harmful and/or dangerous conditions;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 8) the types and conditions of the civil servant's medical insurance and other types of insurance;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 9) types and conditions of social insurance connected with professional service activity;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 10) inclusion of the position held by the civil servant in the list of civil service positions for which rotation of civil servants is provided; 11) probation, where provided for by Article 24 of this Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 12) nondisclosure of state secrets, other secrets protected by federal law and official information, if the official duties regulations provide for the use of such information;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 13) the person’s obligation, after completing studies at a vocational education organization or higher education organization, to perform civil service for no less than the period established by the targeted education agreement, where the studies were funded from the budget of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 14) other terms that do not worsen the civil servant’s position compared with that established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, this Law and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 14 Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 3. The terms of a service contract may be changed only by agreement of the parties and only in writing.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 4. Where a fixed-term service contract is concluded, it states its duration and the circumstances (reasons) that served as the grounds for concluding a fixed-term service contract in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 5. A service contract provides for the parties' liability under the legislation of the Russian Federation for nonperformance or improper performance of the duties and obligations undertaken. A civil servant may not be required to perform official duties not established by the service contract and official duties regulations.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 6. A service contract is concluded in writing in two copies, each signed by the parties. One copy is given to the civil servant and the other is kept in their personnel file. A model service contract form is established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Content and form of a service contract
units.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20

units.text: 8. This part was repealed with effect from 14 February 2025 by Law of the City of Moscow of 29 January 2025 No. 9.

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.label: Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract may be concluded for: 1) an indefinite period;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 2) a fixed period (hereinafter referred to as a fixed-term service contract).
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 2. A fixed-term service contract is concluded for a period of one to five years where civil service relations cannot be established for an indefinite period, taking account of the category of the civil service position held or the conditions of civil service, unless otherwise provided by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 3. A fixed-term service contract is concluded in the case of:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 1) filling the following civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category:
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: а) heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: б) heads and deputy heads of structural subdivisions of the Staff Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow. The list of civil service positions in the ‘managers’ category in other state bodies that are filled under fixed-term service contracts is approved by the employer’s representative;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 2) filling civil service positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 3) filling a civil service position during the absence of a civil servant whose civil service position is retained in accordance with federal laws;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 4) holding a civil service position after completion of education by a citizen who concluded a targeted education agreement at a vocational education organization or higher education organization undertaking subsequent civil service;
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 5) holding a civil service position in a state body established for a specified period or to perform specified tasks and functions;
units.label: Point 5 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 6) holding a temporary civil service position or filling a position during a civil servant's temporary absence by agreement of the parties to the service contract;
units.label: Point 6 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 7) filling a civil service position by a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and whose term of service has been extended beyond that age limit in accordance with part 1 of Article 21.1 of this Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 8) this point was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24,;
units.label: Point 8 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 9) in other cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Point 9 Part 3 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Term of a service contract
units.text: 4. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.

units.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.label: Art. 21.1

units.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: 1. The maximum age for remaining in the civil service is 65. For a civil servant who has reached that age limit and holds a civil service position in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category established to assist a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow, the term of civil service may, with the civil servant’s consent and by decision of the employer’s representative, be extended until the end of that person’s term of office. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group of civil service positions, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the state body or corresponding official who appointed them. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group of civil service positions in the Staff Office of the Moscow City Duma, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the appointing official in agreement with the Chair of the Moscow City Duma. For a civil servant who has reached the maximum age for remaining in the civil service and holds a position in the ‘managers’ category of the principal group of civil service positions in an executive authority of the City of Moscow, the term of civil service may, with their consent, be extended (but not beyond the age of 70) by the executive authority of the City of Moscow or corresponding official who appointed them, in agreement with the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 21.1

units.locator: Article 21.1. Maximum age for remaining in the civil service
units.text: 2. Upon reaching the maximum age for remaining in the civil service, by decision of the employer’s representative and with the citizen’s consent, the citizen may continue working in the state body under a fixed-term employment contract in a position that is not a civil service position. .
units.label: Part 2 Art. 21.1
